text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Good performance in tourism sector in eastern resort of Sousse. Tourist nights rose by 15.4 percent to 1.58 million during first six months of 1997 compared with same period of 1996. Germans head list of tourists.
- Tunisia has eight parks covering 197,093 hectares (487,022 acres).
- About 12 million dinars allocated to infrastructure development in southern region of Kasserine.
- President Ben Ali congratulates Jordan's King Hussein on Throne Day.
